evaluation_start: First complete exchange session opening after registration
evaluation_end: Review after at least 30 complete new sessions and 100 episodes for both policies
review_date: Sample-gated review; no automatic calendar promotion
primary_metric: Paired complete-session underlying return; descriptive until an effect hurdle is separately approved
minimum_effect: UNSET; no promotion permitted before a separate frozen effect hurdle is approved
decision_rule: Counts permit review only. Human-reviewed PR, session-cluster uncertainty, cost/delay stress, drawdown guardrails and rollback required.
source_and_session_basis: Same public TradingView feed/fingerprint, confirmed RTH only; extended bars excluded
episode_definition: Same score60 flips, max2 filled entries/ticker/session, 30min loss/flat cooldown; no-runner exits at first ATR target
overlap_policy: One position per ticker per variant; pair by symbol/session and cluster inference by exchange session
cost_and_delay_assumptions: Reported gross underlying model has no measured spread or costs. Promotion requires explicit adverse spread and delayed-entry stress in a reviewed follow-up. No options payoff inferred.
multiplicity_and_stopping_plan: Single designated no-runner delta against approved runner; no daily tuning or automatic stopping/promotion
